description: SourceProof verifies a factual claim against supplied current web pages. POST JSON to /v1/verify with claim and 1-10 HTTP(S) source URLs; returns a JSON verdict (supported, contradicted, partially_supported, or insufficient_evidence), confidence, citation snippets, retrieval timestamps, and per-source errors. Identical inputs produce deterministic verdict logic, while timestamps and live source content may change.

rpc_types.backend_hint: SourceProof HTTP server on :8080; mount at /
rpc_types.notes: Only GET /, GET /v1/version, GET /health, GET /openapi.json, and POST /v1/verify are expected. Every response is a JSON object.

specs.notes: Version-addressed repository branch URL for the public OpenAPI contract.

serving.backend: The sourceproof container behind a Pocket HA RelayMiner with the REST backend pointed at port 8080. No backend authentication is required; requests are bounded and source URLs are SSRF-checked.

healthcheck.notes: Identity probe pins the backend to SourceProof.
Cheap functional probe; the source is public and the response includes a JSON verdict.

serving.notes: Suppliers should allow the RelayMiner to reach the backend, use a request timeout of at least 15 seconds for upstream page fetches, and apply external rate limiting for public production traffic.
